name: Touno Soutarou
source:
Soutarou is a lion who moved to the village 3 years ago. He's introduced to Hiroyuki by Kyouji. He's a little timid, and has grown up without a father. He is close to Kyouji, because he's the captain of his soccer team.

[From [url=http://en.wikifur.com/wiki/Morenatsu]Wikifur[/url]]
